text:
nina: Heads-up: planning sync for console observability v1. Two competing asks from customers: 1) accurate per-tenant billing exports, 2) SRE-friendly per-route cost + deep trace links. We need a prioritized cut and clear launch criteria by EOD.

tom: Billing wants CSVs and invoice-ready numbers. SREs want trace context attached to error spikes. Both valid. Suggest shipping per-route cost + an "estimated tenant" rollup for billing with a clear uncertainty flag.

yasmin: Implementation concerns: model caching + shared GPU work makes tenant attribution fuzzy. We can do three allocation modes: direct attribution (cheap), proportional by invocations, and heuristic that factors KV cache hits. Need to show which was used in the UI.

greg: Runtime hooks required: inject tenant_id, emit `invocation.weight` and a `cache_hit` boolean; add span tags `tenant.id` and `route`. For traces: keep global sampling low and always sample errors.

nina: Draft sampling proposal:```
trace.global_sampling=0.002 # 0.2%
trace.error_sampling=1.0
cost.aggregation.window=24h
allocation.method=proportional
```
This aims to keep trace storage reasonable while guaranteeing error context.

tom: Bench note from staging: with 0.2% sampling and 100k rps simulated, trace ingestion was ~60GB/day and p95 latency increased ~2.4%. If we switch to 0.1% global we hit ~35GB/day and p95 +1.6%.

yasmin: For billing accuracy, add an "uncertainty" column (percent) and a tooltip explaining cache/non-determinism. That should unblock finance while we improve heuristics.

greg: UX scope for v1: per-route cost table (top 25), tenant rollup CSV export, UI badge for "estimated", and a fast link from cost row -> trace modal (shows sampled traces with trace_id/spans). If no trace available show "no sample".

ops-bot: Created ticket https://tracker/redwood/PRD-700 "obs-v1: per-route cost + estimated tenant rollups + trace-light" assigned to yasmin, greg.

nina: Launch acceptance checklist (must pass to release):
- show per-route cost and export CSV for tenants
- tenant allocation shows uncertainty > 0 flagged
- trace sampling defaults to 0.2% global, 100% on errors and does not increase p95 latency by >4% in canary
- infra cost delta for beta cohort <= 12%
- runtime toggle to disable tracing per-tenant within 15min

tom: Rollout plan: canary at 3% (internal customers) for 1 week, monitor cost & p95, then 10% for 2 weeks with grad escalation. Need comms to sales + billing.

yasmin: Engineering asks: 2 engineers for 3 sprints (aggregation + allocation heuristic + CSV export), 1 infra engineer for a perf bench and canary automation. Also need a small eval harness to validate allocation vs ground-truth on synthetic workloads.

greg: I'll mock the UI templates and link behavior. Keep trace viewer link simple initialy (open external viewer or raw logs if missing).

nina: OK locking this plan unless objections. I'll put the acceptance checklist into the roadmap item and schedule a canary run. Speak now or plan locks at EOD. :lock:"
